sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax or company-registry distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law and customary 'kastom' law; unified national company registry administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, VFSC)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) — regional trade and investment facilitation among Pacific Islands Forum states
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus with Australia and New Zealand — services, investment facilitation and development cooperation (in force 13 December 2020)
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement — regional tariff preferences among Vanuatu, Fiji, Papua New Guinea and Solomon Islands

Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with Australia, New Zealand and Nordic states (Denmark, Faroe Islands, Finland, Greenland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden); no comprehensive DTAAs in force because Vanuatu levies no income tax
World Trade Organization — Vanuatu acceded as a Member on 24 August 2012

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Vanuatu AML/CFT and UBO framework: (i) Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2014 (as amended), administered by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU); (ii) Financial Intelligence Unit Act No. 39 of 2000 (as amended); (iii) International Companies Act No. 31 of 1992 (Cap. 222), as amended by the beneficial-ownership amendments of 2021, requiring every International Company to maintain a UBO register and file UBO particulars with the VFIU Central Beneficial Ownership Register; (iv) Companies Act No. 17 of 1986 (Cap. 191), as amended; (v) VFSC Company Registry Practice Directions and VFIU AML/CFT supervision directives binding on licensed registered agents; (vi) Vanuatu Criminal Code (money-laundering and terrorist-financing offences). FATF grey-list status must be re-verified at onboarding; Vanuatu enacted the 2021 UBO amendments specifically to remediate FATF-identified deficiencies.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — UBO particulars are filed with the VFIU Central Beneficial Ownership Register; they are not publicly searchable, are subject to statutory confidentiality, and are accessible only to the VFIU, VFSC, Vanuatu law-enforcement and supervisory authorities, and authorized registered agents discharging AML/CFT duties. Nominee/opaque bearer-style structures are unavailable: the registered agent must physically verify and maintain the UBO register.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of valid passport of each Director, Shareholder and Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin; or Vanuatu High Commission/Consulate with consular jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarization in origin state; authentication by origin state Ministry of Foreign Affairs; legalization by Vanuatu High Commission/Consulate). Vanuatu is not a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; practitioners must verify accession status before filing.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or regulated bank statement issued within the last 3 months) for each Director and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or regulated bank in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization; alternatively, banker's certificate or registered-agent certification attached to the notarized original

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming account conduct, identity and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating regulated bank with official signature verification
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or banker's certificate acceptable to the VFSC-licensed registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incumbency / company extract for any corporate shareholder or corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or licensed registered agent of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization; plus apostille if the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction is a Hague Apostille Contracting State and the receiving Vanuatu authority accepts it

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Vanuatu International Company and certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: VFSC and its licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Issued directly by VFSC; VFSC-origin documents require no consular legalization except where a foreign bank or platform KYC policy imposes one

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Compulsory screening of all UBOs, directors, shareholders and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated List, US OFAC SDN and Non-SDN lists (including CAPTA), UK HMT Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Australian DFAT Consolidated List, and Vanuatu domestic designated-persons/terrorism lists. PEP identification is performed using commercial risk databases, adverse-media review and VFIU guidance; any PEP, PEP family member or close associate triggers mandatory enhanced due diligence (source of wealth and source of funds evidence) with registered-agent and board sign-off. Screening outputs, risk ratings and underlying documentation must be retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship under the AML/CFT Act 2014.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Company Registry, online Name Reservation and Registration Portal (https://www.vfsc.vu; applications submitted via VFSC-licensed registered agents through the Commission's electronic filing system)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name must be expressed in Latin-script characters; English and French are the statutory working languages of the registry, and Bislama names are permitted only in Latin-script transliteration. Non-Latin scripts (Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic) are not accepted in the registered name. An International Company name must end with a recognized limited-liability suffix: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Corporation', 'Corp', or approved French forms (e.g., 'Société Anonyme'; 'SA'). The name must not be identical or misleadingly similar to any existing registered or reserved name on the VFSC register.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Banker — prior consent of the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu required
Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance — prior VFSC insurance-sector approval required
Trust, Trustee, Fiduciary — prior VFSC trust-company licensing approval required
Fund, Mutual Fund, Securities, Stock Exchange, Exchange, Clearing House, Finance — prior VFSC/Reserve Bank authorization required
Royal, Government, State, Commonwealth, Ministry, Municipal, National (official-context use) — Attorney-General/Ministerial consent required
University, College, Chamber of Commerce, Building Society, Cooperative, Society — sector regulator consent required or statutorily unavailable to an International Company
Vanuatu (as leading element implying Government connection) — restricted; ministerial clearance required
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the VFSC Registry issues a written refusal stating the statutory or administrative grounds. Procedure: (1) file a formal written appeal addressed to the Registrar of Companies, VFSC Registry Division, within 14 calendar days of the refusal, setting out the legal basis, distinguishing features and any attaching regulatory consents (e.g., Reserve Bank of Vanuatu or VFSC conditional approvals for sensitive tokens); (2) pay the non-refundable appeal fee per the prevailing VFSC Fees Schedule; (3) the Registrar issues a written decision within 10 business days of a complete filing; (4) if the appeal is dismissed, the applicant may immediately reserve alternative names or resubmit a revised name with a fresh fee; (5) final recourse lies in judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Judicial Review Act. An unexpired reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30 days; absent renewal, the reservation lapses and a fresh application is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not for statutory compliance. Every International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu (a street address, not a P.O. Box), located at the office of a VFSC-licensed registered agent and staffed during business hours for service of process and official notices. A 'virtual office' may be used only as a foreign operational or marketing address and can never replace the Vanuatu statutory registered office. For a purely digital MMORPG publisher receiving Apple App Store and Google Play payouts, no local physical premises, employees or equipment are required; 100% remote administration through the registered agent and foreign counsel is permissible. The International Company is statutorily prohibited from carrying on local business with Vanuatu residents and from owning Vanuatu land, which is fully consistent with the offshore digital-publishing model. No statutory business license is required for the online game-publishing activity itself, provided the company does not transact banking, securities, insurance, trust or other regulated financial business within or from Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximately 5% cumulative annual probability of an unannounced VFSC/Police/VFIU inspection for a non-licensed International Company with no physical presence and passive digital-publishing activity. Likelihood rises to 30-40% per annum if the company later obtains a VFSC financial or securities license, becomes PEP-adjacent, or receives repeated high-value inbound transfers triggering VFIU risk alerts.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service (year 1)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market tariff; includes custody of UBO register and maintenance of the AML/CFT client file

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization bundle (charter documents and UBO due-diligence file)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public plus Ministry of Foreign Affairs/High Commission (origin state and Vanuatu)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for a standard five-document legalization bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN and domestic sanctions screening (2 individuals)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap 222) of Vanuatu, as consolidated by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 2007, 2010, and 2013; incorporation authority derived from Part II (ss.5-7), registered office and agent obligations under Part III (ss.29-30), share capital rules under Part IV (s.20), and director provisions under Part V (ss.40-44).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry Division, Rue de l'Institut Pasteur, Port Vila, Efate, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association in the statutory Form IC-1, submitted by a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent pursuant to Section 6(1) of the International Companies Act 1992.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. Company may issue one or more shares of par value or no-par value, and shares may be issued for cash, promissory notes, or other consideration as determined by the board (s.20). No escrow account or capital deposit is required for an International Company. The authorized share capital is set at US$50,000 divided into 50,000 ordinary shares of US$1.00 each, of which one share is issued subscribed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1) that the Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission on the date of incorporation are adopted in full; 2) that the allotment of one fully paid ordinary share of US$1.00 to the founding subscriber, who has tendered valid consideration, is approved and recorded in the share register; 3) that the registered office at the office of the licensed Registered Agent, Port Vila, Vanuatu, is adopted as the Company's statutory seat and official address; 4) that the individuals named in the register of directors are appointed directors until the next annual general meeting; 5) that the Registered Agent is irrevocably authorized to file all statutory notices and pay annual fees to VFSC; and 6) that the Managing Director and Company Secretary are appointed officers of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and Pre-Incorporation Name Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); engagement via a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (e.g., a licensed trust and company service provider in Port Vila).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator executes a service agreement with a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent. The agent submits a name availability inquiry to the International Companies Registry, proposing a name ending in 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' and avoiding names prohibited under Section 8 (e.g., 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance', or names implying a connection with the Government of Vanuatu). The agent obtains written approval of the proposed company name from the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Engagement letter with the Registered Agent
Proposed company name (2 alternatives)
Certificate of Incumbency or proof of identity and address of the founder/shareholder
Bank reference letter for the beneficial owner (crypto-gaming source of funds attestation)
Completed KYC/AML questionnaire of the Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused under Section 8, the agent files a fresh name reservation with modified alternatives at no additional government fee; if the KYC submission is queried, the applicant submits notarized identity documents and a source-of-funds declaration within 3 business days to cure the deficiency.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of signatory and the VFSC-licensed Registered Agent acting as attestor.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registered Agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the English language, conforming with the First and Second Schedules of the International Companies Act 1992. The sole subscriber executes the Memorandum by subscribing one share and appointing the first directors. Execution may occur by physical signature (notarized) or by electronic signature in accordance with the Electronic Transactions Act 2000, subject to the agent's attestation. The agent then executes the statutory declaration of compliance stating that all incorporation requirements of the Act have been satisfied.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Form IC-1)
Statutory Declaration of Compliance to be signed by the Registered Agent
Consent of the first director(s) to act (Form IC-6)
Consent of the first shareholder/subscriber
Certified passport copy of the beneficial owner and director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar identifies a deficiency in the declaration of compliance, the agent amends the memorandum within 7 days and resubmits; no penalty fee is imposed if corrected before the 14-day statutory rejection window elapses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Documents and Payment of State Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry (electronic filing via the VFSC portal or physical lodgment at the Registry counter).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registered Agent lodges the executed Memorandum and Articles, together with the declaration of compliance and confirmation of registered office and Registered Agent details, at the VFSC Registry. The Registry assesses the US$250 incorporation fee (plus VT 5,000 stamp duty where applicable), processes the application, and issues a Certificate of Incorporation under Section 7 of the Act. The certificate is conclusive evidence of incorporation and is date-stamped as of the filing date.
required_dossiers: Lodgment form (Form IC-1A)
Filed copy of Memorandum and Articles
Signed statutory declaration of compliance
Notice of registered office and Registered Agent (Form IC-3)
Consent of Registered Agent (Form IC-3A)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registry issues a query under Section 12, the agent must file a response or corrected document within 30 days; failure to respond results in automatic deemed withdrawal. The US$250 fee is carried forward to a new filing without additional government levy if corrected within 60 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Recordation of Share Allotment and Registered Office Details
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry and the Registered Agent (maintenance of statutory registers).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, the Company opens its statutory registers: register of members, register of directors, and register of charges. The single issued share is recorded in the register of members. The registered office is confirmed as the address of the Registered Agent in Port Vila, with the registered agent's consent on file. All statutory records are maintained at the registered office, but the register of members is not open to public inspection under Section 47 of the Act.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Register of Members with first allotment entry
Register of Directors and Officers (Form IC-9)
Registered office consent letter from the Licensed Agent
Share certificate serial-numbered and signed by the directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a statutory register omission is identified during VFSC compliance inspection, the Company has 14 days to file a rectification statement; late filing of the annual licensing declaration attracts a penalty of VT 10,000 (USD 85), curable by payment and submission of the overdue register page.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Formalization: First Board Resolution and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company; minutes attested by the Company Secretary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of incorporation, the directors convene the First Board Meeting (or pass a unanimous written resolution in lieu of a meeting, permitted under Section 14 of the Act). The board adopts the pro-forma resolution covering ratification of incorporation, share allotment, adoption of the registered office, appointment of officers, approval of the corporate bank account mandate, and approval of the branded service agreements for the MMORPG publishing business. Minutes are entered into the minute book and signed by the chair.
required_dossiers: Draft First Board Resolution
Directors' consents to act
Resigned or continuing officer consent forms (Managing Director and Secretary)
Corporate banking mandate and signatory specimen signatures
Auditor or accounting officer engagement letter (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where a director's appointment is challenged for lack of consent, the board executes a retroactive written consent and files a Form IC-9 amendment within 5 business days; failure to file timely consents exposes the company only to an administrative rectification fee of VT 5,000, not invalidation of the resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VFSC Annual License Validation and Compliance Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registered Agent files the annual International Company license declaration and pays the renewal fee (US$250 per annum). The Company confirms that it has engaged in no business activity within Vanuatu, holds no immovable property locally, and maintains its registered agent and registered office. A Certificate of Good Standing may be issued upon request for use in banking and app-store merchant onboarding.
required_dossiers: Annual license return (Form IC-AR)
Proof of registered agent continued appointment
Copy of Certificate of Incorporation
Declaration of non-resident status (no local business solicitation)
Authorization letter from the board to the agent for renewal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual fee is not paid by 30 June, a late penalty of 10% of the annual fee applies; if unpaid for more than 6 months, the company may be struck off under Section 278 of the Act. Reinstatement is available by paying all arrears plus a VT 25,000 reinstatement fee within 7 years, subject to the Registrar's discretion.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing authority applies; the Company is an offshore International Company engaged solely in digital software publishing (ISIC 5820) with no physical manufacturing, warehousing, or retail premises in Vanuatu. The only physical nexus is the Registered Agent's serviced office in Port Vila, which requires neither industrial licensing nor manufacturing permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - the Company is exempt from Vanuatu Business Licence requirements under Section 3(2)(c) of the Business Licence (Amendment) Act 2018, which exempts International Companies licensed under the International Companies Act 1992 from obtaining a local business licence for offshore operations. No operating license is required for software publishing or MMORPG gameplay services within the Republic of Vanuatu.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Government of Vanuatu (operating under the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act No. 12 of 2002).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 3 (No EIA required). The activity is classified as a purely digital service enterprise with zero physical discharge. The Regulation of Development Activities regulations list software publishing and online gaming as exempt development activities requiring no Environmental Impact Assessment, no Environmental Monitoring Certificate, and no building permit. The only physical footprint is a serviced office space within an existing licensed commercial building, which does not trigger any development consent threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste generation arises from server-based MMORPG publishing. All computational infrastructure is hosted on third-party cloud providers (e.g., AWS/Azure), outside Vanuatu's terrestrial jurisdiction. The Company's registered office generates only domestic municipal solid waste (paper, packaging) not exceeding municipal collection thresholds; office tenancy complies with the Port Vila Municipality Waste Management Regulations 2015, requiring segregation of recyclables and disposal through licensed collection contractors. The Company shall maintain a simple environmental compliance record confirming no point-source discharges to land or water and no import of ozone-depleting substances.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The Registered Agent's serviced office holds a valid Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services under Section 18 of the Fire Service Act 2011, with annual inspection of emergency exits, extinguishers, and alarm systems. The serviced building possesses a structural occupancy permit from the Public Works Department. The Company employs no local operational staff; any visiting director or external consultant is covered under the occupational health and safety obligations imposed on the Registered Agent under the Employment Act No. 19 of 2023, requiring first-aid provision, electrical equipment safety checks (relevant to a single workstation environment), and documented workplace induction. The Company shall obtain a Certificate of Compliance from the Registered Agent confirming fire clearance and occupational occupancy suitability prior to commencing active publishing operations from the registered office.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue – Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu (official portal: https://customs.gov.vu)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is generally tax-exempt and is not automatically issued a TIN. If VAT registration becomes necessary (e.g., for local taxable supplies or for zero-rating export claims), the foreign entity must submit a completed VAT registration application (Form VAT 01) to the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, together with the IC registration certificate, certified passport copies of all directors/shareholders, a board resolution appointing a local tax representative, and evidence of relevant business activity. The Department issues a VAT identification number upon approval; the same ID serves as the withholding tax and customs reference number where applicable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election exists under Vanuatu law. The International Company enjoys automatic income tax exemption under the International Companies Act, subject to complying with IC activity restrictions. An IC may optionally elect to register for VAT under the Value Added Tax Act if it makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu above the registration threshold; this election does not affect income tax exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax; no GST or general sales tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 of taxable supplies in any 12 consecutive months (threshold applicable under the Value Added Tax Act; verify current regulations with DCIR)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, API integration, or digital stamping regime is currently in force in Vanuatu. Taxpayers must issue VAT/ tax invoices containing prescribed particulars (including supplier name, VAT identification number, supply description, VAT amount, and date). Records must be maintained for audit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (i) exports of goods physically removed from Vanuatu, (ii) international transport and ancillary services, and (iii) services supplied to non-residents that are performed wholly or predominantly outside Vanuatu or that directly relate to offshore business activity. For an MMORPG digital publishing model, digital services and in-app purchases delivered through Apple App Store and Google Play to non-resident users outside Vanuatu can be treated as zero-rated offshore services where the place of supply is outside Vanuatu and the services are not consumed in Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, or equivalent shipping document
Inward Remittance Certificate, bank statement, or payment provider settlement report evidencing receipt from overseas counterparties
VAT zero-rated supply declaration including exporter TIN, recipient name, and statutory attestation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes strict anti-fraud measures on export zero-rating claims. False declarations, forged export documents, or excluded goods/services improperly zero-rated trigger a VAT clawback at 12.5% plus interest and administrative penalties, typically up to VUV 200,000 per offence and/or imprisonment of up to 5 years under the Value Added Tax Act. Customs-related misdeclarations additionally attract fines and forfeiture under the Customs Act. Retrospective assessments may be issued by the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue upon audit, and abuse of the International Company regime may lead to loss of statutory tax exemption and reclassification for income tax purposes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberalised exchange control framework for International Companies (ICs). Current account payments and capital account transfers are effectively convertible and do not require prior RBV approval for non-resident-owned ICs. Profit remittance is freely permitted provided the bank receives standard supporting documentation evidencing the underlying transaction and the company has no unsatisfied domestic tax or statutory obligations. The practical remittance hurdle is enhanced compliance due diligence at the commercial bank level, principally de-risking pressure from correspondent banks and the need to substantiate the source of funds from digital app store payout statements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement in Vanuatu. Export receipts generated from MMORPG in-app purchases and distributed via Apple App Store and Google Play may be retained in foreign currency or converted to VUV at the discretion of the company. The RBV AML/CFT directives require reporting of suspicious and large cash-equivalent transactions, and banks must retain documentary proof of the commercial or digital service export, although no mandatory repatriation timeline or percentage conversion ratio is imposed on ICs.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with VUV and multi-currency rails

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility as a primary banking rail. RBV does not maintain a dedicated EMI (Electronic Money Institution) licensing regime, and offshore fintech EMIs that operate without an in-country banking licence or a licensed agent cannot offer stable settlement into a Vanuatu IC. Such instruments may be used solely as supplementary payout channels if the underlying funds are first cleared through a licensed domestic ADI and provided the EMI complies with the applicable foreign correspondent bank restrictions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors is not statutorily mandated for account opening. Vanuatu licensed banks generally permit remote onboarding for ICs subject to strengthened KYC, including a scheduled video interview, notarised corporate registers, certified passport copies, and a physical address confirmation for the registered agent. Any live interview is conducted through the bank's compliance officer and is admissible as part of the client acceptance record.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Red flag: beneficiary is an IC with zero local substance and offshore directors transacting high-volume digital app store receipts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Existing corporate registration certificate and IC certificate of compliance from Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; registered agent certificate of current good standing; certified copy of the register of members and beneficial ownership declaration; audited or management financial statements demonstrating the In-App Purchase revenue model; Apple/Google payout remittance advice and merchant agreements; statutory declaration from directors explaining expected transaction flow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Red flag: receipt of funds from low-tax/offshore jurisdictions without clear economic nexus.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial substance letter from Vanuatu legal counsel; executed distributor agreements with Apple/Google detailing the movement of funds; transaction procurement evidence including server-side player data summaries; board resolution authorising bank account and operational mandate; source of wealth backbone prepared for each beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Red flag: no physical office or staff in Vanuatu suggesting shell activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Licensed registered agent agreement in Port Vila; dedicated compliance officer engagement; operational lease or professional workspace coordinates; evidence of active IP ownership in the game engine; mitigation plan demonstrating that passing domestic goods/services through a Vanuatu IC is not the purpose of the account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Red flag: unusual cross-border disbursements to game service providers in high-risk jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Authorised payment matrix signed by directors; original vendor/supplier contracts with developer and cloud infrastructure providers; disbursement schedule linked to royalty or distribution milestone timelines; correspondent bank charge detail forecast; annual internal audit attestation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injection shall be routed through the licensed bank's correspondent network via SWIFT MT103/MT202 remittances. The payment reference must include the IC registration number, company name, and a specific purpose code describing 'capital contribution' or 'subordinated loan'. The bank will require the share issuance or loan agreement filing, a VFSC paid-up capital receipt, and a final full-narrative KYC pack prior to value-dating. For the gaming treasury, funds from Apple/Google generally arrive as aggregated net settlement payouts; these must be matched to the payout statement's payment cycle. The receiving bank will not require RBV prior approval but will perform a POCA 2004 AML screening and will verify the source-of-funds document.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury disbursements will use SWIFT MT103 via the primary ADI for high-volume royalty and service payments to cloud hosting, content delivery network, and indy developer licensors. Where the counterparty requires documentary assurance, a Commercial Letter of Credit (L/C) may be used, with the Vanuatu bank acting as confirming or issuing bank through its international correspondent group. For time-sensitive publisher and payment processor refunds, immediate payment makes use of domestic VUV clearing through the RBV deferred net settlement system; no daytime gross settlement asynchronous balances are permitted for third-party disbursements. All disbursements must be reconciled against the in-app purchase ledger and must not contravene the IC's registered business purpose.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu Vatu / US Dollar outright forwards executed through an RBV-licensed authorised foreign exchange dealer
Offshore US Dollar / Vatu non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) used for hedging App Store settlement exposure where local VUV/USD liquidity is thin
Cross-currency swaps between VUV and USD limited to corporates with substantiated recurring revenue streams, executed via a licensed bank and mirrored by an offshore investment-grade counterparty

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Renewal of Registration of an International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months following each anniversary of the incorporation date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts an immediate USD 100 surcharge plus a 10% monthly arrears penalty; non-payment for 12 consecutive months triggers a VFSC Gazette notice and administrative strike-off under section 206 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], with assets vesting in the State.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Confirmation and Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (record held for VFSC inspection)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted annually with the Annual Return within 3 months of the incorporation anniversary; also required within 30 days of any share transfer or ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or update the beneficial ownership register is an offence under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014 and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Act [Cap. 247], carrying fines up to VT 5,000,000 (approx. USD 42,000); the Registered Agent must report persistent non-compliance to the VFSC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Client Due Diligence and Risk Assessment Refresh (Registered Agent AML/CFT Questionnaire)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent under the AML/CFT Act [Cap. 247] and VFSC Rules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 3 months of the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-cooperation may result in the Registered Agent filing a Suspicious Activity Report or resigning; continued failure to comply is an offence attracting fines up to VT 10,000,000 (approx. USD 85,000) and possible officer disqualification.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is compulsory for Vanuatu International Companies at any activity, asset, or revenue threshold (International Companies Act [Cap. 222], section 62); audit may be imposed only by the company's articles of association, a special resolution of members, or a Court order. This MMORPG entity is unconditionally exempt from independent audit unless voluntarily elected.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No accounting standard is prescribed by the International Companies Act; IFRS or US GAAP is typically adopted when financial statements are voluntarily prepared. There is no obligation to file or publish financial statements with the VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014 and VFSC AML/CFT Rules, the Registered Agent conducts an annual UBO confirmation sweep at each incorporation anniversary; any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be disclosed to the Registered Agent within 30 days, who updates the Register of Beneficial Owners and reflects the position in the Annual Return filed with the VFSC. Non-disclosure by members is a criminal offence under the AML/CFT Act.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory; voluntary certified audit typically USD 5,000 – USD 12,000 per annum if commissioned

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; no income tax statute applies to companies, and an International Company is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes on income, profits, capital gains, and assets under the International Companies Act [CAP 222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate; permanent statutory exemption for International Companies covering income, profits, and assets. A domestic VAT of 15% applies only to onshore supplies of goods and services and does not apply to offshore MMORPG royalty income or app-store settlement proceeds. No capital gains tax, no estate tax, no business license tax on offshore revenue.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return — Form prescribed under s.120 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; filed through the VFSC Online Registry Portal at vfsc.vu or lodged in hard copy by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — one filing per 12-month period aligned to the anniversary of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within six months after each anniversary of the date of incorporation; the annual government fee must accompany the return. Failure to file by the statutory deadline triggers late penalties and, after persistent default, administrative strike-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name, IC registration number, and date of incorporation exactly as shown on the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact English name from the certificate; no trading names, abbreviations, or brackets may be substituted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Vanuatu maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A post office box alone is invalid; the address must be the agent's physical street location in Port Vila or Luganville.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and VFSC licence number of the Vanuatu-licensed registered agent appointed under the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The appointment is mandatory; an overseas corporate services provider without a VFSC licence cannot act as registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, nationality, and dates of appointment of all incumbent directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; the information stays in the confidential VFSC file and is not public, but it is exchangeable under Vanuatu's exchange-of-information arrangements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section E — Shareholders and Beneficial Owner
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholders, issued share capital, share classes, and declaration of every ultimate beneficial owner who is a natural person.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee holdings must be fully disclosed to the VFSC; every ultimate beneficial owner must provide certified passport and proof-of-address documents for the agent's AML file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement confirming that the IC carried on no business within Vanuatu and derived no income from Vanuatu domestic sources during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any onshore trading activity would jeopardise the tax-exempt IC classification and could create VAT and business-licence exposure; onshore sales should be isolated in a separate Vanuatu domestic company.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts the VFSC late penalty of approximately VUV 10,000 (≈ USD 80) per month or part of a month; continued default beyond the renewal cycle accelerates administrative strike-off under s.169 of the International Companies Act, loss of separate legal personality, and a restoration fee of approximately VUV 25,000–50,000 before good standing is reinstated.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return — annual ESR filing prescribed under the International Co-operation (Economic Substance) Act; submitted via the VFSC ESR e-filing portal by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — one ESR return per financial year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 12 months after the end of the IC's financial year; any change in relevant activity status must be notified to the VFSC within 30 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the activity from the statutory list; MMORPG publishing and game-IP monetisation must be marked as 'Intellectual Property Business' where revenue derives from licensing or exploitation of game copyrights, characters, lore, or digital assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Characterise precisely: pure holding of game IP with royalty income attracts the full nexus test, while distributing third-party games may constitute 'Distribution and Service Centre' activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Location and description of the core income-generating activities: decision-making on acquisition, exploitation, maintenance, protection, and licensing of the MMORPG intellectual property.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: CIGA must actually occur in Vanuatu; overseas outsourcing of game development, payment-channel management, or user acquisition to Singapore, the United States, or China can cause automatic failure of the substance test.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time employees, their qualifications, and the physical premises occupied in Vanuatu; board meeting minutes evidencing decisions taken in-country.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee employees are disregarded; employees must be proportionate to the income generated and engaged under Vanuatu National Provident Fund-compliant contracts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenditure attributable to the relevant activity, including rent, payroll, utilities, professional fees, and local research and development costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenditure must be proportionate and actually paid locally; the full nexus approach for intellectual property business requires tracking local R&D expenditure against the income attributable to each IP asset.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signed declaration by the directors that the information is true and complete and that the company satisfies the economic substance test.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Signing officers face personal criminal liability for knowingly false statements; non-resident directors should obtain an independent Vanuatu tax opinion before signing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file, or failure to meet the economic substance test, carries an entity penalty of up to VUV 1,000,000 (≈ USD 8,000) plus daily default surcharges; knowingly false declarations expose directors to fines of up to VUV 250,000 and imprisonment of up to 5 years; persistent breach leads to VFSC strike-off and automatic exchange-of-information notifications to foreign tax authorities.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax; distributions by an International Company to non-resident shareholders are statutorily exempt under the International Companies Act [CAP 222].
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive Double Taxation Agreements. It maintains only bilateral Tax Information Exchange Agreements and participates in the OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters for information exchange. No Vanuatu DTA relief form or Tax Residency Certificate exists because no income tax is levied; if a foreign authority requires proof of status, the VFSC issues a Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incorporation. Any reduction of source-state taxes on cross-border payouts must be achieved under the shareholder's residence-jurisdiction rules, including foreign tax credits, participation exemptions, or CFC/GILTI mechanics, rather than through a Vanuatu treaty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and no treaty-reduced alternative: Vanuatu law imposes no withholding tax on royalty or interest paid by an International Company to non-residents. Source-country taxes determined by the payment channel, such as United States backup withholding, European digital services taxes, or marketplace commissions withheld by Apple and Google, remain final costs at the payer level.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No domestic transfer-pricing statute and no Local File or Master File threshold exist in Vanuatu. The only documentation-linked obligation is Country-by-Country Reporting under Vanuatu's implementation of OECD BEPS Action 13: an MNE group with consolidated group revenue equal to or exceeding EUR 750 million (≈ VUV 93,000,000,000) must file a CbCR return and notification where the Vanuatu IC is the ultimate parent or a constituent entity. Below that threshold, no transfer-pricing documentation is required under Vanuatu law.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines applied as persuasive interpretive authority in the absence of domestic codification
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Co-operation (Economic Substance) Act applies to Vanuatu International Companies carrying on relevant activities, administered by the VFSC. An MMORPG publisher performing IP licensing and monetisation is conducting an 'Intellectual Property Business', a statutorily relevant activity subject to the full nexus approach. The company must demonstrate: (1) management and control in Vanuatu, with board meetings physically held in-country; (2) adequate local employees, premises, and equipment; (3) local expenditure proportionate to the income level; and (4) annual ESR filing. A pure holding vehicle that merely registers game IP and collects Apple or Google payouts without local activity is a 'cash box' and fails the substance test, making dividend and royalty flows through the Vanuatu IC a primary target for foreign CFC and anti-BEPS rules.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion — Abusive Offshore Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing 100% of the group's global MMORPG in-app purchase and licensing profit to the zero-tax Vanuatu International Company while all core income-generating activities, including game development, payment processing, user acquisition, and contract negotiation, are performed by employees or subsidiaries in high-tax jurisdictions with no contracts, invoices, or operational substance in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In Vanuatu: ESR failure triggering penalties of up to VUV 1,000,000 and strike-off. In source and residence states: disallowance of royalty deductions, CFC inclusions under Subpart F and GILTI in the United States or Part 9A CTA 2009 in the United Kingdom, digital services taxes of up to 15%, penalties of up to 200% of the tax understated, and denial of treaty benefits under the BEPS Multilateral Instrument Principal Purpose Test.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil courts will pierce the corporate veil for fraud or sham, ordering shareholders and directors to pay restitution of shifted profits plus interest. Criminal evasion prosecutions have generated travel bans, asset freezes, and imprisonment, with custodial exposure of up to 5 years in the United States and up to 7 years for fraudulent evasion in the United Kingdom. In Vanuatu, a director who signs a false ESR declaration faces imprisonment of up to 5 years and a fine of up to VUV 250,000.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the International Company solely as a registered mailbox: nominee directors, no physical office, no employees, no local bank account, and no board meetings held in Vanuatu, with app-store settlement funds collected through an e-wallet or foreign account; the VFSC, a correspondent bank, or an Apple/Google compliance review classifies the entity as a shell.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC strike-off and deregistration, restoration fees, and administrative penalties. Apple App Store and Google Play may terminate payout accounts and freeze held funds; correspondent banks de-risk the entity; foreign courts may disregard the corporate personality entirely in enforcement proceedings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the shell conceals ownership or evades taxes, courts lift the veil and hold directors personally jointly and severally liable for the company's obligations; directors may be disqualified for up to 10 years from managing any Vanuatu company; criminal fraud prosecutions attract custodial sentences of up to 5 years and confiscation orders.
